description: This file defines the PimModuleController class within the OrangeHRM project, part of the Pim module. It extends an abstract controller class and handles redirect logic to the default PIM module path.

classes.name: PimModuleController
classes.description: Controller class that manages the PIM module's operations, specifically handling redirect to the module's default page.

methods.name: handle
methods.description: Handles the request by retrieving the default PIM module path and redirecting the user to it.
